description: Create a one-time full-report order for an existing scan. This does not transfer funds. Only set consent_immediate_delivery true after the payer has expressly agreed to immediate delivery and applicable withdrawal terms. The payer must send USDT on Polygon and then submit its transaction hash using verify_full_report_payment.

consent_immediate_delivery.description: Set true only after the payer explicitly agrees to immediate delivery and the applicable withdrawal-right terms.

name: create_full_report_order
title: Create a USDT Polygon payment order
